clue.text: Something painful with which to batter this, for example

parts.note: a pang is a sudden sharp pain
a ram (battering ram) is used to batter down doors

explanation.surface: Someone is told to take something painful and beat this with it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'This' points at the puzzle itself: the grid uses every letter of the alphabet (note the Z, Q, J and X).
explanation.definitionFit: A sentence or puzzle using every letter of the alphabet at least once; this crossword is an example.

clue.text: Part of weapon in front holding divorcee up

indicators.note: the phrase for being in front contains the other piece, holding it inside

parts.note: to be ahead is to be in front

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word for divorcee is read from bottom to top

parts.note: an ex is a former spouse, such as a divorcee

explanation.surface: A soldier's weapon part is out in front, carrying a former spouse aloft.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns the divorcee word round, reading XE in the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The cutting head of an axe is one part of that weapon.

clue.text: Infidels love one intermittently interrupting work-out

indicators.note: the second piece interrupts at a different point, so the insertions are spaced apart
the numeral breaks into the work-out word, sitting before its last letter

parts.note: a gym session is a work-out
one is the Roman numeral I
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: Unbelievers keep breaking into someone's exercise session.
explanation.walkthrough: 'intermittently' tells you O and I go in separately: G-O-Y-I-M.
explanation.definitionFit: Goyim is a Yiddish term for non-Jews, i.e. those outside the faith, hence unbelievers from that viewpoint.

clue.text: A snack eaten by bishop and judge

indicators.note: the snack sits inside the bishop's letters, as if swallowed

parts.note: RR, Right Reverend, is the style of a bishop
a bite is a quick snack

explanation.surface: A cleric and a judge share a quick snack.
explanation.walkthrough: Right Reverend is the formal style of a bishop, abbreviated RR.
explanation.definitionFit: An arbiter settles disputes, acting as a judge between parties.

clue.text: Giggle about women's social medium

indicators.note: the giggle word goes around the abbreviation for women

parts.note: a titter is a nervous giggle
W is the abbreviation for women

explanation.surface: A medium at a seance laughs about women's affairs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'medium' suggests a psychic, but here it is a means of communication.
explanation.definitionFit: The microblogging platform (now X) is a social media service.

clue.text: Go unsteadily west — go off

parts.note: eggs addle when they go off

explanation.surface: An instruction to totter westward and then go bad.
explanation.definitionFit: To waddle is to walk with short swaying steps, like a duck: moving unsteadily.

clue.text: Infant the man lost in part of London

parts.note: a tot is a small child

indicators.note: something lost is all over the place, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A child and a man have gone missing somewhere in London.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lost' rearranges THE MAN into TENHAM.
explanation.definitionFit: Tottenham is a district of north London, home to Spurs football club.

clue.text: Raised no single current issue

indicators.note: in a down clue, raised means the whole string is read upwards

parts.note: taken as written
I, the Roman numeral one, means single
a tide is a current of water

explanation.surface: No current issue has been brought up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Raised' turns NO I TIDE upwards into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An edition is one issue of a newspaper or magazine.

clue.text: Film old Albanian monarch securing right to cleanse smell

indicators.note: the king's name holds the next pieces inside it

parts.note: Zog was King of the Albanians from 1928 to 1939
to bathe is to wash or cleanse
a reek is a strong bad smell

explanation.surface: A former Balkan king takes a right to wash away a stink.
explanation.walkthrough: Zog, the last King of the Albanians, is a crossword regular.
explanation.definitionFit: The 1964 film with Anthony Quinn as an exuberant Cretan, based on the Kazantzakis novel.

clue.text: Challenge to make God heartless

indicators.note: the middle letter of the verb is removed, leaving it without its heart

parts.note: to deify is to make a god of someone

explanation.surface: A blasphemous challenge to turn the Almighty cruel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartless' sounds like cruelty but removes the central I of DEIFY.
explanation.definitionFit: To defy someone is to challenge or openly resist them.

clue.text: Stood around lancing blister, evidence of injury

indicators.note: the shuffled letters pierce the blister word, sitting inside it

parts.note: a blain is an old word for a blister or sore

indicators.note: around means the letters of stood are moved about

explanation.surface: Someone stood by while a blister was lanced, leaving signs of a wound.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' rearranges the clue's first word as OODST.
explanation.definitionFit: A patch of dried blood on cloth or skin shows that someone was hurt.

clue.text: What to do with straight hair? Pass

definitions.text: What to do with straight hair?
definitions.meaning: you might give straight hair a perm, curling it
a pass is a document allowing entry

explanation.surface: A hairdresser asks what to do with straight hair, then says pass.
explanation.walkthrough: The first part reads as PERM IT, an instruction to curl the hair.
explanation.definitionFit: A permit is a pass or licence giving official permission.

clue.text: Report of headless chicken in waste disposal unit

indicators.note: the trimmed chicken word goes inside the waste container

parts.note: a bin is where waste goes

indicators.note: the first letter of the chicken word is removed

parts.note: a pullet is a young hen

explanation.surface: A grim report of a decapitated hen found in the rubbish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'headless' leaves ULLET once the young hen loses its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A bulletin is a short official news report.

clue.text: Sketch fetching a silly price

parts.note: dumb means stupid or silly
a rate is a charge or price

explanation.surface: A drawing sold for a ridiculous sum.
explanation.definitionFit: To adumbrate is to outline or sketch something faintly.

clue.text: Note to buxom former lover's agent

parts.note: mi is the third note of the sol-fa scale
DD is a large bra cup size
leman is an archaic word for a lover

explanation.surface: A message to a curvaceous ex's representative.
explanation.walkthrough: DD as a bra size stands for buxom; 'former' flags LEMAN as archaic.
explanation.definitionFit: A middleman is an intermediary, acting as agent between two parties.

clue.text: Apply kneecap to part of face, causing breach

parts.note: the chin is the lowest part of the face
the cap, or first letter, of knee is K

explanation.surface: Someone knees another in the jaw, sparking a rift.
explanation.walkthrough: 'kneecap' looks like the bone but means the top letter of KNEE.
explanation.definitionFit: A chink is a narrow gap or crack, a breach in armour or a wall.

clue.text: What's said to audience on A11?

definitions.text: What's said to audience on A11?

parts.words: What's said to audience on A11?
parts.note: the road number splits into the letter A and the number eleven, and eleven players form a cricket or football team

explanation.surface: Someone talking to listeners while driving the A11, a British trunk road from London to Norwich.
explanation.walkthrough: A theatrical remark plus the letter A then a word for a team of eleven; the road number disguises it.
explanation.definitionFit: In theatre, a remark made to the audience that other characters supposedly cannot hear.

clue.text: Many cut a left

parts.note: to sever is to cut off

explanation.surface: Plenty of people cut one and left.
explanation.definitionFit: Several means more than two but not a great number, close to many.

clue.text: Will's offensive sexual organ intruded

definitions.note: read as 'Will is', the 's acting as a link

indicators.note: the flower organ is pushed into the middle of the offensive word

parts.note: the Tet offensive was a 1968 campaign in the Vietnam War
the stamen is the male sexual organ of a flower

explanation.surface: Someone named Will has had an obscene body part pushed in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'offensive' looks like an adjective for the organ but is a noun: the 1968 Vietnam campaign.
explanation.definitionFit: A testament is a legal will, as in 'last will and testament'.

clue.text: Space in canonical hour for Roman funny man

indicators.note: the printing space goes inside the hour word

parts.note: terce is the church service at the third hour
an en is a printer's unit of space

explanation.surface: A gap in the church day for a Roman comedian.
explanation.walkthrough: An en is a printer's measure of space, half an em.
explanation.definitionFit: Publius Terentius Afer was a comic playwright of ancient Rome.

clue.text: Incipient new way up

parts.note: an ascent is a way up a mountain

explanation.surface: A fresh route up is just beginning.
explanation.definitionFit: Nascent means just coming into existence, so beginning or emerging.

clue.text: Force to remove tangerine rind from roquette salad

indicators.note: the peel letters are taken away from the salad leaf before shuffling
a salad is a mixture, so the remaining letters are tossed together
the rind is the outer skin, the first and last letters of tangerine

explanation.surface: A recipe step: peel the tangerine for a rocket salad.
explanation.walkthrough: Take T and E (the outside of 'tangerine') from ROQUETTE and rearrange the rest ('salad') as the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Torque is a twisting force that causes rotation.

clue.text: Baddy, at any point in time, receiving unopened sex aid

indicators.note: the time word takes in the trimmed sex aid

indicators.note: the first letter is removed, leaving the item without its opening

parts.note: a dildo is a sex toy

explanation.surface: A villain who has ever been caught with a sex toy still in its packaging.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unopened' suggests still boxed, but drops the toy's first letter, leaving ILDO.
explanation.definitionFit: An evildoer is a wicked person, a villain.

clue.text: Dependable nonsense about public transport

indicators.note: the nonsense word goes around the vehicle

parts.note: rot means rubbish or nonsense
a bus is public transport

explanation.surface: Claims that the buses are reliable are dismissed as rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: Robust means strong and sturdy, so reliable and dependable.

clue.text: Pretty little girl, keen on Guys and Dolls and open to all?

parts.note: bi, bisexual, means attracted to both men and women
Jo is a girl's name
U is the film certificate for universal viewing

explanation.surface: A lovely girl who adores the musical Guys and Dolls is welcoming to everyone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Guys and Dolls' looks like the musical but means men and women; U is the British film rating for all ages.
explanation.definitionFit: Bijou describes something small and elegant, typically a compact attractive home.

clue.text: Histrionic sort of monkey, shaking off a cold in Arden, perhaps

indicators.note: the trimmed monkey goes inside the rearranged name
perhaps signals a possible version of the word arden, its letters reordered
the monkey word sheds the letters for a and cold

parts.note: the macaque is an Old World monkey

explanation.surface: A monkey in the Forest of Arden overdoes things while getting over a cold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shaking off' leaves MAQUE; 'perhaps' rearranges the forest name as DRAEN, around it.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who overreacts theatrically is called a drama queen, an idiom for a histrionic person.

clue.text: Man in the street on line to prophet

parts.note: Joe Public or Joe Bloggs is the ordinary man in the street

explanation.surface: An ordinary passer-by phones a prophet.
explanation.definitionFit: Joel is one of the minor prophets of the Hebrew Bible.

clue.text: Female students absorbing princess's hypocritical utterances

indicators.note: the pair of learners takes the royal name inside

parts.note: L for learner, doubled for plural students
Princess Anne is the Princess Royal

explanation.surface: Female students taking in a royal's speech find it insincere.
explanation.walkthrough: ANNE goes between the two Ls.
explanation.definitionFit: Flannel is British slang for evasive, insincere talk.

clue.text: About to go to Spain and return the sentiment

parts.note: re means about or concerning
to quit is to leave or go
E is the international vehicle code for Spain (España)

explanation.surface: Someone thinks of moving to Spain and finds the feeling reciprocated.
explanation.definitionFit: To requite love is to reciprocate it, giving back the same feeling.
